ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Disqualified"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Disqualified_Reason_CC__c)), AND( ISPICKVAL(Disqualified_Reason_CC__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(Disqualification_Comments_CC__c) ) ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Disqualified Reason. If the reason is ‘Other’, please provide Disqualification Comments
